title: [9332][platform_tests] CLI test - test_show_platform_psustatus fails due to invalid LED status
author: tjchadaga
body:

     ---------------------------------------------------

     - SONiC Support Forums - https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/sonicproject

     ---------------------------------------------------
     BUG REPORT INFORMATION
     ---------------------------------------------------
     Use the commands below to provide key information from your environment:
     You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST
-->

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
No status is retrieved for PSU LED, which causes test_show_platform_psustatus to fail. The below message is seen
```
Failed: Unexpected PSU led_status value: 'N/A'
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run platform_tests/cli/test_show_platform.py::test_show_platform_psustatus or test_show_platform_psustatus_json


#### Describe the results you received:
```
duthosts = <tests.common.devices.duthosts.DutHosts object at 0x7fbe69ad6a10>
enum_supervisor_dut_hostname = 'str2-z9332f-01'
def test_show_platform_psustatus(duthosts, enum_supervisor_dut_hostname):
"""
@summary: Verify output of `show platform psustatus`
"""
duthost = duthosts[enum_supervisor_dut_hostname]
logging.info("Check pmon daemon status on dut '{}'".format(duthost.hostname))
assert check_pmon_daemon_status(duthost), "Not all pmon daemons running on '{}'".format(duthost.hostname)
cmd = " ".join([CMD_SHOW_PLATFORM, "psustatus"])
logging.info("Verifying output of '{}' on '{}' ...".format(cmd, duthost.hostname))
psu_status_output_lines = duthost.command(cmd)["stdout_lines"]
psu_line_pattern = get_dut_psu_line_pattern(duthost)
# Check that all PSUs are showing valid status and also at least one PSU is OK
num_psu_ok = 0
for line in psu_status_output_lines[2:]:
psu_match = psu_line_pattern.match(line)
>           pytest_assert(psu_match, "Unexpected PSU status output: '{}' on '{}'".format(line, duthost.hostname))
E           Failed: Unexpected PSU status output: 'PSU 1  0NXFRC   TH0NXFRC1797103P01E2A00          11.00          32.00       384.00  OK        N/A' on 'str2-z9332f-01'
cmd        = 'show platform psustatus'
duthost    = <MultiAsicSonicHost> str2-z9332f-01
duthosts   = <tests.common.devices.duthosts.DutHosts object at 0x7fbe69ad6a10>
enum_supervisor_dut_hostname = 'str2-z9332f-01'
line       = u'PSU 1  0NXFRC   TH0NXFRC1797103P01E2A00          11.00          32.00       384.00  OK        N/A'
num_psu_ok = 0
psu_line_pattern = <_sre.SRE_Pattern object at 0x55cdc1c6d860>
psu_match  = None
psu_status_output_lines = [u'PSU    Model    Serial                     Voltage (V)    Current (A)    Power (W)  Status    LED', u'-----  ------...  OK        N/A', u'PSU 2  0NXFRC   TH0NXFRC1797103P01DWA00           0.00           0.00         0.00  NOT OK    N/A']
platform_tests/cli/test_show_platform.py:191: Failed
```

#### Describe the results you expected:
Test case should pass
